description: Renovate only refreshes the pinned base-image digests in the root Dockerfile; Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) owns npm, pip and GitHub Actions updates.

packageRules.description: The python image is referenced as `FROM python:${PY_VER}`, so its tag and digest live in the PY_VER ARG; leave it to the custom manager below so the dockerfile manager can't propose a competing update.

Base image tags (Node major, PY_VER's Python line, Debian release) are deliberate choices, not routine bumps; see python-nightly-canary.yml for how PY_VER moves. Only refresh the digest behind the current tag.
Refresh all base-image digests in one weekly PR so the Node and Python stages are rebuilt together.

customManagers.description: Track the digest pinned in the Dockerfile's PY_VER ARG (tag@sha256:...), which FROM python:${PY_VER} consumes.
